correctness.rationale: PASS: Complete independent enumeration of labelled simple graphs on 1..4 vertices yields possible positive maximum subgraph edge/vertex densities {1/2,2/3,3/4,1,5/4,3/2} (independent_checks.py: SIX_SPECTRA_OK). For each fixed H, classical subgraph threshold at n^-1/rho_max(H) gives 0/1 occurrence outside these six critical powers; finite Boolean combinations preserve 0/1 limits. The chosen six patterns are strictly balanced with automorphism counts 24,4,6,2,2,2 respectively, checked by independent full label-permutation enumeration, so critical copy counts tend to Poisson means 1/24,1/4,1/6,1/2,1/2,1/2. At each distinct critical alpha, the other five indicators have deterministic limits; direct parity gives e^-1/24, 1-e^-1/4, e^-1/6, 1-e^-1/2, e^-1/2, 1-e^-1/2, all strictly (0,1). The asymptotic theorem is an invoked published theorem, not inferred from finite enumeration.
